purpose.summary: This is a batch COBOL program (ORCR0640) that is part of the ORCA JMA Standard Receipt Software system for Japanese medical billing. It processes inpatient (nyuin) receipt/claim data, reading and writing indexed ISAM files (RECE62, RECE64, RECE65) to generate or update medical insurance claim records. The program handles complex Japanese medical billing rules including point calculations, co-payment amounts, and various insurance categories.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical insurance billing (Japanese NHI receipt processing)

verdict.notes: The file is encoded in EUC-JP Japanese but was decoded as latin-1, causing the Japanese comments to appear as mojibake. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source ORCA (JMA Standard Receipt Software) project used in Japanese medical clinics. The COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) whose content is not shown but are counted as copy_count=0 by the mechanical indicator — likely because the COPY lines themselves are present but the copybook bodies were not inlined. The program is large (8156 lines, ~388KB) and production-quality.
